title: ApexMail System Prompts
description: Schema for data/system_prompts.json — the shared system prompt catalog referenced by compact training, validation, and test JSONL records.

prompts.description: Map of prompt ID to system prompt content.

SystemPrompt.description: A single system prompt entry identified by its hash or ID.

content.description: The system prompt text content, typically in ChatML format.

sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the content field for integrity verification.
